trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna (Matrimonial Case No.43/2017)
case_name: Mrs. Pramiti Bose vs Mr. Kabir Shankar Bose
facts_of_case: The husband filed a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(i-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act 1955 before the Principal Judge, Family Court, New Delhi. The wife filed a transfer petition before the Supreme Court, which directed the transfer of the case to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna.

legal_principles.principle: Liberal approach should be adopted for pre-trial amendments.
legal_principles.held: It has been canvassed that soon after getting the knowledge of the fraud played upon him by his wife in concealing the fact that she was suffering from a sexually transmitted disease known as Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) Chlamydia, the husband-petitioner of the matrimonial case immediately filed the petition for amendment seeking annulment of the marriage on the said ground as primary relief.

legal_principles.principle: Amenments should not introduce new facts, but can be allowed if the foundation for such facts is already present in the main petition.
legal_principles.held: It has been contended that the amendments do not introduce a new fact at all as the averments in the main petition contain the foundation for such facts which is no surprise to the wife-petitioner.

outcome.result: Appeal disposed of with consent of parties
outcome.final_order: The impugned order dated 09.02.2017 allowing the amendment of pleadings was allowed with consent of parties.
